headline: Quarterly growth was mixed, with a few firms posting strong top‑line gains while the market leader showed only modest revenue expansion.
summary: Coforge led the pack with 53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised its EBIT margin guidance. Infosys trimmed FY27 revenue guidance to 1‑2% after a 1.5% YoY increase, signalling slower momentum. Most peers posted double‑digit growth, driven by AI‑related deals, but profit margins varied. Overall sentiment remains positive but uneven.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue acceleration
themes.detail: Several companies highlighted AI contributions, with Infosys reporting 29% AI revenue growth, HCLTech’s AI revenue at $219 m, and Mphasis noting 66% of contract value was AI‑led.

themes.title: Margin and guidance adjustments
themes.detail: Infosys cut its FY27 revenue guidance, while Coforge raised its EBIT margin target to 16%. HCLTech introduced a modest 2.5‑4% FY27 growth outlook.

leaders.why: 53.6% YoY revenue growth and upgraded FY27 EBIT margin guidance.

laggards.why: Only 1.5% YoY revenue growth and a cut to FY27 guidance.
